name: Upload
purpose: Complete upload control with drag and drop, paste, multi-file list, and per-file progress.

label.description: Accessible label for the drop zone.

dropzoneLabel.description: Visible hint inside the drop zone.

files.description: Controlled list of { name, size, progress? } entries; progress is measured by the caller, never simulated.

onFiles.description: Called with the File array when files arrive.

states.name: uploading
states.description: At least one file in flight.

antiPatterns: Do not upload without explicit user consent.
Do not accept files beyond the declared accept list.

a11y.focus: Drop zone and browse button are focusable.
a11y.labeling: Drop zone label plus browse button describe the control.

responsive.strategy: Full width drop zone; file list stacks.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
